process_fair_mon_dataset: process a FAIR Montreal Campus dataset pickle file and save hand and object trajectory keypoints as npz
recover_original_array: recover a 21-dimensional MANO joint array from a 20-dimensional array by inserting a fill value at index 13
index_original_array: reindex a 21-dimensional MANO joint array from Francois ordering to Changhao ordering
trajectory_from_grasp: create a trajectory from a single grasp by interpolating between start, grasp, and end poses using hand landmarks
interpolate_pointclouds: interpolate point cloud frames along the first dimension to produce a target number of frames using linear interpolation
